CustomField.description: Phased reservation opening. While on, only a beneficiary with Login_Enabled__c ticked can sign in, and everyone else gets the same generic response an unknown Emirates ID gets, with no SMS. Off is how this ships, so deploying it changes nothing. Does NOT apply during exploration mode: browsing stays open to everyone and this only bites once reservations are open. Switch it on only AFTER the first batch has been released, or every beneficiary is locked out. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Batch Release Mode
